name: vayancy-travelos
displayName: Vayancy TravelOS — Mediterranean Luxury Clearing Rail
description: Direct AI booking rail for luxury villas, boutique hotels, and catamaran charters across Greece and the Mediterranean. Live PMS availability, verified direct owner rates (0% OTA commission markup), 15-minute inventory hold locks, and instant Stripe checkout.

optionalHeaders.X-Tenant-Key: Optional API key for PMS partners and property managers to scope searches to their private portfolio.

prompts.name: find_luxury_villa
prompts.description: Search verified Mediterranean luxury villas and boutique hotels with private pool and sea view (0% OTA fee).

prompts.name: mediterranean_charter
prompts.description: Search private catamaran and sailing yacht charters across Mediterranean islands (Ionian, Cyclades, Saronic).

prompts.name: compare_ota_savings
prompts.description: Calculate exact guest savings (18%-25%) booking direct with property owner vs Airbnb / Booking.com.

prompts.name: hold_reservation
prompts.description: Place a 15-minute atomic calendar lock on PMS inventory and generate direct Stripe checkout.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Search verified Mediterranean luxury villas, boutique hotels, and vacation rentals available for direct booking without OTA commission. Returns live pricing, photos, bedrooms, and direct booking links.

location.description: Destination name in Greece or Mediterranean (e.g. 'Mykonos', 'Santorini', 'Lefkada', 'Crete', 'Athens Riviera', 'Paros', 'Corfu')

tools.name: search_charters
tools.description: Search private catamaran and yacht charters across Mediterranean islands (Ionian, Cyclades, Saronic). Live fleet availability, skippered or bareboat, with zero broker commissions.

embarkation_port.description: Starting marina or island port (e.g. 'Lefkada Marina', 'Athens Marina Alimos', 'Mykonos Marina', 'Corfu Gouvia')

check_in.description: Charter start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (typically Saturday-to-Saturday)

check_out.description: Charter end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

skippered.description: Whether a professional skipper is requested (true) or bareboat (false)

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check real-time calendar availability for a specific accommodation against property management systems (PMS). Always verify before quoting.

tools.name: get_rate_details
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive rate breakdown, direct owner discounts, cleaning fee, taxes, and cancellation policies for a stay.

tools.name: create_hold
tools.description: Place a 15-minute reservation lock on the property calendar and generate a direct Stripe checkout link. Call when the traveler confirms they want to proceed.
